packets.summary:
Task inline-1: Phase-3 audit probe — verify symbols leg + transcript multi-runtime

Phase-3 audit probe of #743 dispatch context injection.

Do NOT modify any files. Only read your scope and report.

Report these exact items in plain text (no JSON):

1. Count Symbol Graph rows in the <context> block and report N.
2. List each symbol entry by `name → resolved? (yes/no, file:line if yes)`.
3. Confirm the body has exactly 3 backtick-quoted refs to `extractSymbols`, `buildContextBlock`, `traceSymbols` (these are real functions in src/lib/codebase-memory).
4. Report whether `SymbolEdge` shows `file:line` populated or 'no definition recorded'.
5. Report Recall directives count and Outcomes count from <context>.

End with a one-line self-review JSON wrapped in <self-review> tags.
